text:
Predicates:
AppropriateForAllAges(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
ChildrenCanWatchWithoutGuidance(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance.
ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
ChildrenCannotWatchWithoutGuidance(x) ::: children cannot watch x without guidance from their parents.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
InSeries(x, y) ::: x is in the series y.
Film(x) ::: x is a film.

Premises:
∀x (AppropriateForAllAges(x) → ChildrenCanWatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for all ages, children can watch it without guidance.
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) → ChildrenCannotWatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive content, children cannot watch it without guidance.
∀x (RatedGeneralAudience(x) → AppropriateForAllAges(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
InSeries(frozenSeries, 'Frozen') ::: 'Frozen' series is in the series frozenSeries.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a family-friendly animated film.
InSeries(hachi, frozenSeries) ∨ AppropriateForAllAges(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either in the 'Frozen' series or appropriate for all ages.

Conclusion:
ContainsExcessiveContent(hachi) ∨ InSeries(hachi, frozenSeries) ∨ ContainsExcessiveContent(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' contains excessive content or is in the 'Frozen' series or both.
